nieuw.titel: Consider two Fell Bat units for mobile scenario play
nieuw.tekst: Consider two units of Fell Bats when preparing for Domination and Baggage Train. He preferred the two units for the scenarios he expected to play.
nieuw.waarom: He valued being able to fly in unit strength nine for Domination and the combination of Fly 10, Swiftstride and Skirmish for Baggage Train.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: For breaking war machine crews, he acknowledges that four bats are probably better than three: losing one reduces their attacks, and distant bats are difficult to bring back.

bronnen.citaat: so they were no-brainers for me to run two units.

extraCitaten.citaat: It's four is probably better than three

nieuw.titel: Use chaff to intercept dangerous overruns
nieuw.tekst: Place cheap chaff in the path of a possible enemy overrun when it could otherwise reach a valuable unit.
nieuw.waarom: He describes the 45-point bat unit as insurance to save one of his big hitters if the opponent rolled high.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He placed Fell Bats in case the Giant Cave Squig rider broke through and overran towards his Mortis Engine or Tomb Banshee.

bronnen.citaat: doing defensive duty for 45 points to save one of my big hitters

extraCitaten.citaat: overran straight forward into one of one of say like my mortise engine

nieuw.titel: Value all-round movement when choosing chaff
nieuw.tekst: When available, favour chaff that can move in any direction.
nieuw.waarom: He regards the freedom to reposition at different angles as exceptionally powerful.
nieuw.voorbeeld: His Fell Bats drew interest on a flank, returned to block a possible overrun, then moved behind an enemy unit to extend its flee path.

bronnen.citaat: being able to just flick flick around at any sort of angle

nieuw.titel: Fit mobile chaff into pockets outside enemy charge ranges
nieuw.tekst: Find pockets where your mobile chaff can fit without entering enemy charge ranges. Check how far the lead or last model can move when arranging the unit there.
nieuw.waarom: He says this can leave the opponent with little choice but to ignore the unit.

bronnen.citaat: find the spots on the board that you can sink into

nieuw.titel: Choose weak targets for chaff to attack
nieuw.tekst: Choose weak targets for your chaff, and be willing to wait until those targets become available.
nieuw.waarom: He did not want his bats stuck fighting wolves and judged that taking around 100 points from a war machine would more than justify their cost.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He was willing to commit his Fell Bats against Doom Diver Catapult or bolt thrower crews, but disagreed that he should have attacked the Goblin Wolf Rider Mob.

extraCitaten.citaat: just to trot around until the Doom Diver became available to hit.

nieuw.titel: Use chaff to obstruct enemy marching
nieuw.tekst: Position chaff within eight inches to force enemy march tests, and block lanes that enemy units would otherwise march through.

bronnen.citaat: And you can block those lanes of marching.

nieuw.titel: Hide fast units for late objective grabs
nieuw.tekst: Consider keeping cheap flying units or fast cavalry behind a hill, then sending them out to claim objectives late in the game.
nieuw.voorbeeld: His Fell Bats helped him secure objectives in the tournament's first two rounds.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He notes that the tournament format he played allowed this contribution even though the bats were not core.

bronnen.citaat: behind a hill or something and then fly out and grab objectives

bron.citaat: you can deploy them early and wait for your opponent to do things.

aanvullingen.toelichting: He gives the same advice to use chaff as early deployment drops while waiting to see the opponent's placements.

bron.citaat: it's going to have to bounce through them much further than it normally would.

extraCitaten.citaat: it can then go all the way off the board if they're not careful.

aanvullingen.toelichting: He spaces chaff behind an enemy to extend its flee move, potentially sending it off the board.

bron.citaat: move them right up behind these Boar Boyz.

extraCitaten.citaat: So neither of these units could really charge

aanvullingen.toelichting: He uses his bats' movement in any direction to move behind ranked enemies and escape their charges.

bron.citaat: at the start of the game you have to have a role for these units.

extraCitaten.citaat: Like if they survive what's the plan with them in the late game

aanvullingen.toelichting: He repeats the need to give chaff a specific role, including a plan for surviving units in the late game.

overgeslagen: Skipped tournament scores, sponsor and hobby talk, balance complaints, rules explanations without advice, and battle narration that did not clearly establish a recommendation.
